children: Generation Income Properties entered into an inducement agreement with an existing warrant holder to drive cash exercise of 4,074,359 outstanding warrants at $1.05 per share. In return, the company will issue new unregistered five-year warrants to purchase up to 200% of the exercised amount (approximately 8.15 million shares) at the same $1.05 exercise price, subject to stockholder approval and customary ownership caps. The company plans to file a resale registration for the underlying shares within 30 days after stockholder approval. Maxim Group acted as exclusive financial advisor, earning a $299,465 fee.
